description: Landed on PR #173 as 23052b2eb. The corpus widening sweep (never read behavior/, drove the standalone semantic drive no door runs, ~110 s per gate) is deleted. The matrix-lane alternative was measured and rejected: only diagnostic.code fixtures log telemetry, and logging every lane takes a json fixture from 1.75 s to 35.6 s with a 17 MB trace (fz-t75 territory). Replacement: return_ladders_are_pinned_per_activation pulls two fixtures (return_tuple_ladder, json_roundtrip) through the product pull the doors take and pins, per activation above five revisions, (function, revisions, widened) as a sorted table: build/1 17 widened; json_roundtrip value/1, val/1, decode/1, array/2, array_element/2 at 17 widened plus 25 array_item/2 and array_next/2 activations climbing 6..17 unwidened. 2.7 s, byte-identical across six processes. Finding on fz-kdt.177: the product pull's 103 extra activations feed the shared returns; the population drives the ladder.

comments.text: The three product-pull aborts pinned in CORPUS_PRODUCT_PULL_ABORTS are the ICE filed as fz-0rx; when it is fixed the pin empties and is deleted.

title: Return ladders are pinned per activation on the goal program
